extracted.name: Quick Alfredo Sauce
extracted.description: This Alfredo sauce made with half-and-half is rich and creamy with less fat. It's quickly made on the stovetop in just 5 minutes and great over pasta.
instruction_lines: Melt butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Whisk flour and garlic salt into butter until mixture is smooth. Slowly beat half and half into flour mixture until completely incorporated.
Whisk Parmesan cheese, parsley, and garlic into sauce; bring to a simmer. Cook and stir until sauce has thickened, 4 to 5 minutes. Use immediately or refrigerate.
